name: vwap_mean_reversion_basic_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: Stocks that deviate significantly from VWAP during the first 90 minutes tend to revert because VWAP represents the fair institutional price. Large early deviations are often caused by retail order flow or algo overshoot on news, which institutional participants then fade. The edge persists because retail flow is structurally noisy and institutions use VWAP benchmarks for execution, creating a gravitational pull. The edge is small enough (~25 bps) that it falls below the threshold for dedicated HFT capital allocation.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 50 crore INR AND price > 100 AND price < 10000
session: 09:30-15:15 IST (avoid first 15 min and last 15 min)

long.confirmation: close[t] > close[t-1] AND close[t-1] > close[t-2] (two consecutive green bars after deviation)

short.confirmation: close[t] < close[t-1] AND close[t-1] < close[t-2] (two consecutive red bars after deviation)

entry.entry_price: limit order at close of confirmation bar

exit.stop_loss: 1.5 * ATR(14) from entry OR 0.5% from entry, whichever is tighter
exit.trailing_stop: move stop to breakeven after 50% of target reached
exit.time_stop: exit if not at target within 60 bars (60 min)
exit.signal_exit: exit if VWAP_dev_pct crosses zero (reversion achieved)

risk.position_sizing: fixed INR 1L per trade, reduce to 50K if daily loss > 1000 INR

filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:30 or after 14:30 IST
filters.volume_filter: skip if current bar volume < 0.5 * SMA(volume, 20)
filters.trend_filter: prefer longs when NIFTY 50 > VWAP_NIFTY, shorts when NIFTY 50 < VWAP_NIFTY
filters.event_filter: no trades on budget day, RBI policy days, F&O expiry day
other_filters: skip if stock has earnings scheduled today

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — more quant desks adopting VWAP reversion, but retail noise is structural

weaknesses: In strong trending days (>2% NIFTY move), VWAP reversion fails and stops are hit repeatedly
Early morning deviations may not be noise but genuine information — stock may keep moving away from VWAP
Requires precise VWAP calculation; tick-level VWAP differs from 1-min bar approximation
prior_art: VWAP mean reversion is a well-documented institutional execution strategy. Kakushadze & Serur (2018) catalog it in '151 Trading Strategies'. VWAP reversion alpha has been declining in US equities per AQR research, but Indian markets are less efficiently arbitraged due to lower quant penetration.
notes: Edge math: 0.55 * 50bps - 0.45 * 42bps = 27.5 - 18.9 = 8.6 bps gross. After costs (6 bps slippage RT + 2.5 STT + 0.5 exchange + ~2 brokerage ≈ 11 bps), net is ~-2.4 bps on this conservative calc. Need tighter stops or better win rate. Revised: with 0.58 win rate and 1.3 W:L → 0.58*50 - 0.42*38 = 29 - 16 = 13 bps gross, net ~2 bps. Marginal. Strategy needs careful parameter tuning in backtest.
